_comment: Authoritative Kazi MCP catalogue mirroring the Kazi backend (io.b2mash.b2b.b2bstrawman.mcp). Phase 78 = read-only. Phase 81 adds correspondence write-back (resolve_matter_by_email, file_correspondence, attach_document, propose_task). Phase 82 adds correspondence read-back (list_correspondence, get_correspondence). The grounding linter (scripts/validate-kazi-skill-grounding.py) validates every skill's tool/resource reference against this list. When the backend catalogue changes, update this file and re-run the linter.
